Common.name: Axe of Despair
Common.desc:
(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)
The equipped monster gains 1000 ATK. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can Tribute 1 monster; place this card on the top of your Deck.

Common.name: Enemy Controller
Common.desc:
Activate 1 of these effects.
● Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.
● Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

Common.name: Lightning Vortex
Common.desc: Discard 1 card; destroy all face-up monsters your opponent controls.

Common.name: Man-Eater Bug
Common.desc: FLIP: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.

Common.name: Nimble Momonga
Common.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Gain 1000 Life Points, then you can Special Summon any number of "Nimble Momongas" from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.
